look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Lesson fourteen
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 4, lesson T14, Candlesticks: open, high, low, close; a glowing candle with its four price ticks; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: From line to candle
scenes.desc: One fictional minute of BTC drawn as a line squeezes into a single candle; its four prices tag on; more candles line up into a chart.

scenes.name: Four prices
scenes.desc: A candle sums up one time window: open, high, low, close defined; a day of temperature readings (24, 22, 33, 29 C) forms the same shape.

scenes.name: Watch one form
scenes.desc: A live 1-minute fictional candle: open 60,000, the price dips (red body) to a low of 59,940, climbs (green) to a high of 60,120, and closes at 60,080.

scenes.name: Body and wicks
scenes.desc: Body and wicks defined on the finished candle: body 80, upper wick 40, lower wick 60, range 180 USDT.

scenes.name: Up and down candles
scenes.desc: Close above open: up (bullish), usually green; close below open: down (bearish), usually red; same high, low and 80 USDT body.

scenes.name: Doji
scenes.desc: The close slides to 60,005: a 5 USDT body, a doji; buyers and sellers ended about even; no prediction.

scenes.name: The two rules
scenes.desc: Four sliders: moving the close above the high pushes the high up; moving the open below the low pushes the low down; the candle turns red when close < open.

scenes.name: From candle to chart
scenes.desc: The candle slides into a 12-candle fictional chart: time left to right, price bottom to top, each open near the last close, the last candle still forming.

scenes.name: Wick is not close
scenes.desc: Common mistake: the wick top 60,200 read as the close; a dot travels up and back to 60,040; the close is the body edge.

scenes.name: Try it
scenes.desc: Pause and read a red candle: open 60,150, high 60,200, low 59,950, close 60,000; a down candle, 150 USDT below the open.

scenes.name: Know the limits
scenes.desc: A candle describes the past, the newest one is still forming, long wicks mean fast moves and slippage, WAIT and NO_TRADE are always allowed.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three key points and one question: where did a red candle from 60,100 to 60,020 open?

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: next lesson T15, 1m / 5m / 15m timeframes.
